name: Wolfhart Pannenberg

VINIT.justification: The state of non-being prior to the creative act of the God of the future.

TANCH.justification: The ultimate closure and containment of all historical meaning in the eschaton.

AFWD.justification: The linear progression of events toward their final theological destination.

AREV.justification: The influence of the future end-state upon the present identity of things.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of individual historical events into a coherent whole.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-referential event that identifies the end of history within history itself.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of history into the anticipated future and the current provisional reality.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of all historical fragments into the singular truth of the eschaton.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative confirmation of theological truth at the conclusion of history.

EVALF.justification: The negative state of incomplete knowledge prior to the final revelation.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous presence of the future end within the current historical moment.

IFIX.justification: The permanent and irreversible record of an event as it occurs in time.

phase_3.void_description: The absence of historical manifestation and divine self-disclosure.
phase_3.true_description: The realization of the Kingdom of God as the truth of all things.
phase_3.false_description: The isolation of events from their universal historical context.
phase_3.both_description: The proleptic tension where the end is present but the process continues.

steps.domain_action: The God of the future initiates the possibility of historical existence.
History moves forward as a sequence of contingent events.
Each event is recorded as a permanent fact within the timeline.
Events aggregate into a chain of universal history.
The resurrection of Jesus splits history into the provisional and the final.
The T-arm carries the anticipated glory of the eschaton.
The church advances the mission toward the end of time.
The F-arm carries the ongoing suffering and ambiguity of the present.
The future end exerts a retroactive pull on the meaning of current suffering.
The believer holds the tension of the already and the not yet.
The identity of God is recognized through the proleptic event.
The general resurrection reunites the anticipated future with the lived past.
The Kingdom of God closes the system of history as a completed whole.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Reason acting upon the data of universal history.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Theological discourse and the interpretation of historical signs.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The collective tradition and the record of historical events.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The divine economy of time leading toward the eschaton.
phase_5.alfs_store: The biblical witness as the primary source of proleptic data.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The contingency of historical events and the risk of atheism.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A fragmented world of disconnected and ambiguous occurrences.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A unified totality of meaning where every part relates to the whole.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The final state recovers all information lost during the historical process.
